confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on several aggregator and blog sources of mixed dates and currencies, cross-checked roughly against each other. The wine glass has no direct Merida restaurant price; it is set from the local beer relationship (about twice a draft beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings. FX: the only RBA figure found was dated 2026-03-20, so it is not the latest observation available on 2026-10-16. The search returned no live RBA table, so I did not verify the value on the RBA page itself. Treat it as unconfirmed and stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Mexican mid-sized tourist cities with similar restaurant pricing. Sources put Merida's cost of living well below US levels, and food and drink prices were cross-checked against Expatistan, Combien-coute, and cafe and restaurant listings. Accommodation was estimated from general knowledge of Merida's hostel and guesthouse market. Peso conversions used roughly 18 MXN per USD, based on early-October 2026 quotes.
